name: Better Proposals
description: Better Proposals is a proposal and document platform for creating, sending, tracking, signing, and collecting payment on interactive sales documents.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Better Proposals API token, then let agents list bounded redacted proposal lifecycle summaries or inspect one explicit proposal under a fixed read-only policy. Relay excludes contacts, companies, pricing, signatures, payments, links, content, settings, raw access, and every provider mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: BETTER_PROPOSALS_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Better Proposals API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated customer-owned token in Better Proposals on a Premium or Enterprise account.

capabilities.label: List proposal metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted proposal lifecycle summaries without contacts, companies, pricing, signing, payments, links, or content.

capabilities.label: Inspect proposal metadata
capabilities.description: Read one explicit proposal's redacted lifecycle metadata without private deal data.

allowed.label: List proposal metadata
allowed.description: List up to 50 privacy-redacted proposal lifecycle summaries from one bounded provider response.

allowed.label: Inspect proposal metadata
allowed.description: Inspect privacy-redacted lifecycle metadata for one explicit Better Proposals proposal ID.

blocked.label: Access private proposal data
blocked.description: Document bodies, sections, contacts, companies, pricing, quotes, signatures, payments, URLs, activity, merge tags, and attachments are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or send documents
blocked.description: Proposal, cover, quote, company, and document-type creation or changes, sending, signing, payment, deletion, and status mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Access account configuration
blocked.description: Templates, settings, brands, custom merge tags, currencies, users, integrations, credential generation, and account administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk access
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary filters, status collection routes, pagination, polling, retries, batches, exports, and provider-response pass-through are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only proposal lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: Two fixed privacy-redacted proposal metadata reads run automatically through a customer-owned broad API token.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Customer ownership, fixed read routes, strict projection, token secrecy, result bounds, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway confines the broad customer token to three fixed read-only routes and strictly projected proposal lifecycle metadata.
Railway confines the broad customer token to three fixed read-only routes and strictly projected proposal lifecycle metadata.

providerSetup.blocker: Better Proposals exposes a customer-generated broad API token rather than delegated scopes, and API usage after trial requires a Premium or Enterprise plan. No account, plan confirmation, token, live provider session, Railway change, or production acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized customer confirms an eligible plan, generates a dedicated API token, stores it through Relay's encrypted connection flow, then separately validates proposal-count health, bounded redacted listing, explicit proposal reads, rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Better Proposals documents JSON success/error envelopes, the customer-generated Bptoken request header, GET /proposal, GET /proposal/:PROPOSAL_ID, GET /proposal/count, and broader proposal, template, company, quote, currency, settings, and creation routes that Relay blocks.
Better Proposals lists API and Zapier access on Premium and Enterprise rather than Starter.
Better Proposals describes CRM, payment, Zapier, live-chat, and project-management integrations around its proposal workflow; Relay exposes none of those broader integration surfaces.
